premise.en: Noor's storybook came apart, and its pages blew away into different worlds. Every page you bring back makes the book stronger.
premise.ar: تَمَزَّقَ كِتَابُ نُور، وَطَارَتْ صَفَحَاتُهُ إِلَى عَوَالِمَ بَعِيدَة. كُلُّ صَفْحَةٍ تُعِيدُهَا تَجْعَلُ الكِتَابَ أَقْوَى.

_upcomingComment: Destinations the child can SEE but not yet play. They exist so the map reads as a journey rather than a single button, and they carry a title and nothing else: revealing the story of a locked Adventure spends the surprise before the child gets there. The one-line `peek` is shown only once the Adventure before it is finished, which is what makes finishing feel like it opened something. These are deliberately NOT in `adventures` - that list is validated to name real, playable content.

peek.en: The last page went up, far past the clouds.
peek.ar: صَعِدَتِ الصَّفْحَةُ الأَخِيرَةُ بَعِيدًا خَلْفَ الغُيُوم.
